desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Perform</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo Application</color> <color=#ffffffa6>on self and prepares the Skill</color> <color=#ffffff>Greataxe Strike</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, then prepares the skill</color> <color=#ffffff>Master's Strike</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Greataxe Strike</color>
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 3</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and prepares the Skill</color> <color=#ffffff>Master's Strike</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Master's Strike</color>
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 3</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) If the opponent has</color> <color=#ffffff>Damage Negation</color> <color=#ffffffa6>or</color> <color=#ffffff>Shield</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Status on their side of the field, or they have</color> <color=#ffffff>Damage Negation</color> <color=#ffffffa6>or</color> <color=#ffffff>Shield</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Combat Status, attach 1 stack of</color> <color=#ffffff>Might of Stone</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self after your character uses a Skill.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Might of Stone</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The character to which this is attached deals +1 DMG. If the opposing character is under a shield or damage reduction effect, deal +3 DMG instead.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 1</color> <color=#ffffffa6>(Can stack, no stack limit)</color>

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ffe699>Geo Application</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>is applied without dealing any DMG, the Elemental Reaction triggered will ignore DMG-dealing effects:</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Cryo Crystallize</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: The opponent's active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points).</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystallize</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: The opponent's active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points).</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Pyro Crystallize</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: The opponent's active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points).</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Electro Crystallize</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: The opponent's active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points).</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Elemental Burst</color>
When the character's Energy is maxed out, you can consume that Energy to use a powerful Elemental Burst.
<color=#ece5d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
